TZA.note: Only a planned Pan-African Green AI and Robotics data centre; no facility for hire in service stated.

facts.fact: TTCL's director general said the National ICT Broadband Backbone (NICTBB) has built over 14,000 km of fibre connecting all regions and districts and neighbouring countries in the EAC and SADC.
TTCL's director general said the national backbone is connected to 11 international submarine cable systems, including SEACOM, EASSy and 2Africa, via Dar es Salaam and Mombasa.

TZA.note: Gives 56.3 million internet users as a count with no share of population or survey.
No nationally owned data centre for hire in service stated.
